title: v1.51.0 breaks throughput handling — skip to v1.51.1 or later

detection.reason: read from the image TAG of the ebs-csi-controller / ebs-csi-node workloads — a digest-pinned image (@sha256:…) or a mirror that renames the tag is not resolved and reads clean

quote: **WARNING: This version contains a bug that breaks handling of throughput. It is strongly recommended to skip directly to `v1.51.1` or later.**
remediation: This release mishandles StorageClass throughput: volumes can be created without the throughput you asked for. Upgrade straight past it (to the target version); if the cluster runs it now, re-check gp3 volumes created while it ran (aws ec2 describe-volumes --query 'Volumes[].[VolumeId,Throughput]').
verifyCommand: kubectl get deploy,ds -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.name | test("^ebs-csi-(controller|node(-.+)?)$")) | .metadata.namespace as $n | .metadata.name as $w | .spec.template.spec.containers[] | select(.name == "ebs-plugin") | "\($n)/\($w): \(.image)"'  # a tag of v1.51.0 is the affected build
